research_question: What is the effect of daily cotrimoxazole combined with another antimalarial drug (mefloquine or dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine), compared with daily cotrimoxazole alone or with placebo, on low birth weight (<2500 g) in HIV-positive pregnant women?
treatment_label: Daily cotrimoxazole plus antimalarial (mefloquine or dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine)
control_label: Daily cotrimoxazole alone or with placebo
outcome_description: Incidence of low birth weight (<2500 g) in infants born to HIV-positive pregnant women
positive_direction: A lower incidence or risk of low birth weight in the combination therapy arm compared to control (favoring cotrimoxazole plus antimalarial)
search_queries: cotrimoxazole mefloquine dihydroartemisinin pregnancy malaria trial
HIV pregnant women cotrimoxazole antimalarial low birth weight controlled trial
cotrimoxazole chemoprophylaxis combination malaria pregnancy randomized outcome
inclusion_criteria: Studies evaluating HIV-positive pregnant women receiving daily cotrimoxazole prophylaxis (CTXp)
Intervention evaluating daily cotrimoxazole combined with an additional antimalarial drug (such as mefloquine or dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine) versus daily cotrimoxazole alone or with placebo
Empirical comparative studies reporting quantitative birth weight outcomes, specifically low birth weight (<2500 g)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, or study protocols without results)
No comparison between cotrimoxazole combined with an antimalarial and cotrimoxazole alone or with placebo
No quantitative outcome data on low birth weight (<2500 g) or birth weight from which risk ratios or event counts can be extracted
Completely unrelated to malaria chemoprevention in HIV-positive pregnant women
moderators_to_extract: Specific antimalarial co-administered (e.g., mefloquine vs. dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine)
Control regimen (cotrimoxazole alone vs. cotrimoxazole plus placebo)
Geographic region and local malaria transmission intensity
Maternal antiretroviral therapy (ART) status or regimen
effect_size_note: Risk Ratio (RR) pooled using reported low birth weight events (<2500 g) and total randomized participants per arm.
